title: Audit public GSE51981 sample labels and independence
blocked_reason: All 148 arrays reconciled. The required per-array participant and recent-treatment evidence remains unresolved. See docs/research-notes/GSE51981_COHORT_AUDIT_2026-11-13.md.
question: Can every intended case, control, and other-pathology sample be traced to a source-backed phenotype, phase, tissue, and independent donor assignment?
scope: Metadata and methods audit only. Do not infer a clinical label from a GSM title; do not access patient-level restricted data.
steps: Check source terms, metadata fields, sample identifiers, diagnosis group definitions, menstrual phase, and donor independence.
Build a source-cited field mapping and explicit unknown/exclusion inventory; do not fabricate assignments.
Record whether an auditable case/control contrast is possible before viewing expression outcomes.
deliverables: A PR with a metadata-only audit report under docs/research-notes/ and links to evidence; no sample-level data in Git.
A clear go/no-go or blocked decision for a GSE51981 limma replication.
acceptance: Each included field assignment has a primary source citation or is marked unresolved.
The 37 other-pathology samples are not relabeled as pathology-free controls.
Donor independence and phase uncertainty are explicitly reported; no biology result is claimed.
